title: Pangolin Ki Jeebh Ka Khaufnaak Sach! 🦔 #shorts
idea: A pangolin's tongue can grow up to 40 cm long and is anchored inside its chest thorax rather than its mouth.

lines.text: Iss anokhe jaanwar ki jeebh munh nahi, chhaati se judi hoti hai!
Hum baat kar rahe hain Pangolin ki, jiski jeebh 40 cm lambi hai!
Ye 40 cm jeebh iske 30 cm ke chote sharir se bhi badi hai!
Itni lambi jeebh rakhne ke liye munh mein bilkul jagah nahi!
Isliye iski jeebh ka root seedha chest aur ribcage mein hota hai!
Kya aapko pehle kabhi Pangolin ka ye secret pata tha?

facts.claim: Pangolin tongue can extend up to 40 cm long
Smallest pangolin species start from 30 cm in size
Root of tongue is attached in the thorax instead of hyoid bone in mouth
